Loved by many, our fresh baked challah is a beautiful addition to any tabletop. Our delicious challah is baked to a deep golden brown and features a sweet, buttery brioche-like texture. This soft, flakey bread is perfect to snack on alone and makes the perfect French toast, delicious bread pudding and tasty sandwiches! Certified Kosher and Pareve, Green's Challah is baked in a dairy-free, nut-free kitchen and made with only all-natural ingredients.
